items.title: Inversionistas prevén ventas y cautela en el mercado brasileño tras el triunfo de Lula
items.author: Rodrigo Campos, Marcela Ayres
items.creator: Rodrigo Campos, Marcela Ayres
items.summary: El presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, ganó la reelección el domingo, derrotando al senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro y planteando una prueba para los inversionistas, que esperan que las recientes apuestas por un cambio de Gobierno se reviertan en una semana previsiblemente volátil.
items.body:
El presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, [USN:L2N46C00P TEXT:"ganó "][USN:L2N46C00P TEXT:"la reelección"] el domingo, derrotando al senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro y planteando una prueba para los inversionistas, que esperan que las recientes apuestas por un cambio de Gobierno se reviertan en una semana previsiblemente volátil.
Los mercados se habían movido con fuerza ante la expectativa de un giro hacia la derecha desde que Bolsonaro, hijo del expresidente condenado Jair Bolsonaro, quedara inesperadamente en primer lugar en la primera vuelta hace tres semanas. La bolsa brasileña (.BVSP) cerró el viernes casi un 7% por encima de su nivel al inicio de la primera vuelta, mientras que el real se había apreciado casi un 5% frente al dólar estadounidense. Los futuros sobre las tasas de interés habían indicado que se esperaba que el endurecimiento de las finanzas públicas permitiera una bajada de los costos de financiación.
"Esperamos una fuerte reacción del mercado el lunes, con una reevaluación agresiva, una ola de ventas de activos y unos futuros sobre tasas de interés que probablemente alcancen su límite superior poco después de la apertura", dijo Luis Felipe Vital, director de estrategia macroeconómica de Warren Investimentos.
Durante los próximos cuatro años, Lula deberá frenar el crecimiento de la deuda brasileña al tiempo que protege los programas sociales y la inversión. Para los inversionistas, la cuestión es si su enfoque gradual para sanear las finanzas públicas podrá reducir los costos de financiación. Sin la confianza de que pueda cumplir sus promesas, los prestamistas podrían exigir tasas de interés más altas, lo que aumentaría la deuda del Gobierno y encarecería el crédito para las empresas y los hogares.
"Los inversionistas quieren un compromiso claro y creíble con la disciplina fiscal", dijo Alejo Czerwonko, director de inversiones para mercados emergentes de UBS Global Wealth Management. "Prevemos que el repunte que siguió a la primera vuelta ya esté en gran medida descontado en los precios, y que el ánimo se mantenga débil hasta que surja un plan fiscal claro".
Czerwonko señaló que los inversionistas esperan que se ponga fin al gasto que acompañó a la campaña y que se trace una vía creíble para estabilizar la deuda pública. "Esto también implica una relación de trabajo con un Congreso de tendencia opositora, ya que ningún plan fiscal se aprueba sin él", añadió.
El equipo de Lula se propone alcanzar un superávit presupuestario primario de alrededor del 1,3% del producto interno bruto para 2030. Eso dejaría fondos para cubrir parte de los intereses, reduciendo la necesidad de nuevos préstamos. Sin embargo, la deuda pública ya supera el 82% del PIB, mientras que las pensiones y otros gastos obligatorios por ley limitan las fuentes de ahorro.
"Las políticas de Lula han hablado de recortes de gasto, pero no ha entrado en detalles sobre cómo se concretarán", señaló Divya Singaravelu, directora de investigación de Meridian 1305 Capital. Afirmó que la elección del próximo ministro de Finanzas sería una primera señal para los mercados, y añadió: "Queremos ver cómo serán el presupuesto y el límite de gasto para 2027".
Quien ocupe el cargo tendrá que explicar cómo encajan los compromisos de campaña dentro de esos límites fiscales.
"La clave es que, aunque prevalezca el pesimismo a corto plazo, los inversionistas tendrán que estar atentos a cómo avanza la agenda económica del Gobierno a medio plazo", señaló Gustavo Sung, economista jefe de Suno Research.
"Lo más importante ahora es observar cómo se organiza el Gobierno de cara a 2027."

items.title: ミャンマー、イラン産航空燃料を軽油と偽装輸入　軍政関与の形跡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２６日　ロイター］ - ミャンマーが、イランから航空燃料を「軽油」と偽って輸入し、それにミャンマー軍事政権が関与していることが、人権団体の報告書やロイターが確認した文書などで分かった。背景には、米国の制裁がある。米国の制裁は効果はあるものの完全ではなく、イランは燃料売却で外貨を確保し、ミャンマーは民間航空の運航と空爆の双方を維持することができていることになる。

ミャンマー国軍は、国内の少数民族武装組織掃討で空爆を行っている。米政府は２０２３年、空爆で民間人が犠牲になっているとして、ミャンマーのジェット燃料産業に制裁を科した。

２４年、国連の専門家報告書は、タワン・オイル・トレーディングというタイの企業が、ミャンマー国軍への航空燃料供給元で、タイのサイアム商業銀行(ＳＣＢ）が主要な仲介役と指摘した。報告書を受け、ＳＣＢは、マネーロンダリング（資金洗浄）防止法を順守しており、ミャンマー関連の取引は合法で武器取引とは関係がないと表明した。タイ規制当局は、ミャンマーが関与する取引を厳密に精査するよう国内銀行に命じた。

ロイターは今年１月、２４年１０月から２５年１２月にかけて、イランがミャンマーに対する航空燃料の主要な供給元だったと報じた。米国の制裁対象となっている「リーフ（現：マリス）」、および「ノーブル」という２隻のタンカーが主に輸送を担ったとした。

ミャンマーの人権保護などを訴える「ジャスティス・フォー・ミャンマー」は２６日、ミャンマー軍政が軽油と偽って航空燃料を輸入していたと結論付ける報告書をまとめた。

２５年１２月の「リーフ」によるミャンマーへの燃料輸送に関し、ジャスティス・フォー・ミャンマーが提供したミャンマー外為当局の文書によると、当局はリーフが到着する数日前に、貨物を「航空燃料ではなく」軽油と記載した輸入書類を発行するとミャンマーの発注元に伝えていた。 

ジャスティス・フォー・ミャンマーは、文書は一時的に一般公開されていた軍政のサーバーから入手したと述べた。ロイターは検索エンジン「DuckDuckGo」上で該当文書の切れたリンクを確認し、過去にそのサーバー上に存在していたことを裏付けた。文書に記載された納入日や燃料の数量は、ロイターが別途精査したイラン産航空燃料の輸送記録とも一致した。

items.title: Drone attack on Russia's Voronezh region kills two men, governor says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A drone attack in Russia's Voronezh region killed two men and injured 17 people, including a child, regional governor Alexander Gusev said on Monday.
items.body:
A drone attack in Russia's Voronezh region killed two men and injured 17 people, including a child, regional governor Alexander Gusev said on Monday.
Air defence systems had destroyed 113 drones over the region, Gusev wrote on the MAX messaging app.
Fires also broke out at several industrial sites, Gusev said.
A passenger train bound to Moscow from Anapa in Russia's Krasnodar region, popular among Russian vacationers, was also damaged and five passengers injured, Russian Railways said.
Train services through Voronezh have been suspended.
Reuters could not independently verify the report.

items.title: フーシ派、サウジ石油施設と首都空港攻撃と発表　戦闘激化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２６日、サウジアラビアの東西を結ぶ原油パイプラインのポンプ施設と首都リヤドの空港を攻撃したと表明した。戦闘激化で原油供給が滞り、紛争がさらに拡大する恐れが高まっている。

イエメンで活動するサウジ主導の連合軍はこれに先立ち、首都サヌアで弾道ミサイル発射装置２基を破壊したと発表した。うち１基はリヤドに向けたミサイル発射に使われたもので、連合軍はミサイルを迎撃したとしている。

フーシ派が発表した攻撃について、サウジ側からの確認は現時点で得られていない。

フーシ派はサウジの空港、港湾、石油施設に弾道ミサイルや無人機（ドローン）を発射しており、中東紛争を巡り米国の同盟国であるサウジに圧力が高まっている。

フーシ派はリヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港も攻撃したと表明。同空港では今月初め、フーシ派が実行を表明した攻撃で１３人が死亡。サウジ国内での攻撃としては過去１０年超で最多の死者を出した。２５日にターミナル２カ所で業務を再開していた。

事情を知る関係者２人によると、メッカ協定に参加するサウジ、トルコ、パキスタンの高官は２６日、テヘランでイラン当局者と会談し、地域での連携について協議する予定だ。

会談が実現すれば、イランと連携するイエメンのフーシ派によるサウジへの攻撃が激化して以降、イランと３カ国全てが参加する初の高官級接触となる。

items.title: El ex primer ministro japonés Yasuo Fukuda muere a los 90 años, según el Nikkei
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El ex primer ministro japonés Yasuo Fukuda, quien aprovechó su breve mandato para estrechar los lazos con los países vecinos de Asia, especialmente con China, ha fallecido a los 90 años, informó el lunes el diario económico Nikkei.
items.body:
El ex primer ministro japonés Yasuo Fukuda, quien aprovechó su breve mandato para estrechar los lazos con los países vecinos de Asia, especialmente con China, ha fallecido a los 90 años, informó el lunes el diario económico Nikkei.
El político japonés, el primer hijo de un primer ministro que también llegó a ocupar el cargo, murió el jueves a causa de una insuficiencia cardíaca, según Nikkei.
Fukuda asumió como primer ministro tras la repentina dimisión de Shinzo Abe en 2007 y permaneció en el cargo menos de un año, un mandato aún más breve que el de dos años de su padre, Takeo.
Licenciado en Economía por la prestigiosa Universidad de Waseda, en Tokio, Fukuda pasó casi dos décadas ascendiendo en una empresa petrolera —con una estancia de dos años en Estados Unidos— antes de renunciar para convertirse en secretario político de su padre cuando este asumió como primer ministro en 1976.
Elegido en 1990 para la Cámara Baja del Parlamento japonés, la de mayor poder, Fukuda fue secretario jefe del Gabinete entre 2000 y 2004. Dimitió tras ser uno de varios ministros que admitieron no haber cotizado al sistema de pensiones.
Conocido por su carácter irritable, Fukuda, que llevaba gafas, fue blanco de críticas en 2003 por unos comentarios que hizo bajo condición de que no se publicaran, en los que sugirió que las mujeres que vestían de forma provocativa buscaban que las violaran.
Cuando sucedió a Abe, Fukuda bromeó con que quizá le había tocado la peor parte al asumir el cargo, dada la división del Parlamento y la capacidad de los partidos de oposición para retrasar la aprobación de leyes.
Frustrado por el bloqueo del proceso legislativo, Fukuda dimitió en 2008 y fue el segundo de seis primeros ministros que renunciaron tras apenas un año aproximadamente en el cargo.
Conocido por su talante conciliador en política exterior, Fukuda visitó China en varias ocasiones después de dejar el cargo, en un esfuerzo por mejorar unas relaciones a menudo tensas.
Fukuda deja un hijo, Tatsuo, que también es diputado y ha sido considerado como un posible futuro primer ministro.

items.title: Kampf gegen Wohnungsnot - Regierung bringt einfachen Baustandard auf den Weg
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Angesichts der Wohnungsnot in Deutschland hat die Bundesregierung einen Gesetzentwurf für einfacheres und günstigeres Bauen vorgelegt. Durch eine Änderung des Bauvertragsrechts soll unter Verzicht auf bestimmte Komfortstandards so auch schneller gebaut werden können, wie aus einem Entwurf des Justizministeriums (BMJV) zum sogenannten Gebäudetyp E hervorgeht, der Reuters am Montagmorgen vorlag. Erfahrungen aus Pilotprojekten zufolge können die Baukosten dadurch um zehn bis 15 Prozent gesenkt werden.
items.body:
Angesichts der Wohnungsnot in Deutschland hat die Bundesregierung einen Gesetzentwurf für einfacheres und günstigeres Bauen vorgelegt. Durch eine Änderung des Bauvertragsrechts soll unter Verzicht auf bestimmte Komfortstandards so auch schneller gebaut werden können, wie aus einem Entwurf des Justizministeriums (BMJV) zum sogenannten Gebäudetyp E hervorgeht, der Reuters am Montagmorgen vorlag. Erfahrungen aus Pilotprojekten zufolge können die Baukosten dadurch um zehn bis 15 Prozent gesenkt werden.
Die Neuregelung sieht eine freiwillige Option vor. Nur wenn die Parteien eines Bauprojekts den neuen "Gebäudetyp E-Basisstandard" ausdrücklich vereinbaren, gelten die vereinfachten Regeln. Andernfalls bleibt es bei den bisherigen, höheren Standards. An zwingenden staatlichen Vorgaben etwa zu Brandschutz, Statik oder Belichtung ändert das Gesetz nichts. "Bauen in Deutschland muss einfacher und günstiger werden. Denn wir brauchen mehr bezahlbaren Wohnraum", erklärte Bundesjustizministerin Stefanie Hubig (SPD). "Mit dem Gebäudetyp-E-Gesetz ebnen wir dafür den Weg." Bauministerin Verena Hubertz (SPD) sagte: "Jeder Euro, den wir nicht in überflüssige Standards stecken, ist ein Euro für mehr bezahlbaren Wohnraum. So wird Bauen günstiger und bleibt rechtssicher."
Dem Entwurf waren monatelange Abstimmungen innerhalb der Regierung vorausgegangen. Ursprünglich hatten Justiz- und Bauministerium bereits im November 2025 ein gemeinsames Eckpunktepapier vorgelegt. Die Verbände der Bau- und Immobilienwirtschaft sowie mehrere Bundesländer hatten die Regierung zuletzt wiederholt zu mehr Tempo bei dem Vorhaben gedrängt. Bislang scheitert das Bauen nach einem günstigeren Standard oft an rechtlichen Unsicherheiten, da Bauunternehmen bei Abweichungen von etablierten Normen Rechtsstreitigkeiten fürchten. Der Gesetzentwurf wird nun an die Länder und Verbände versandt, die bis zum 13. November 2026 Stellung nehmen können.

Nepal’s nationalism is changing. New political order puts jobs and growth ahead of grievances

Balendra Shah’s government has centred its promise on reform and employment, priorities that have little to do with hostility towards India.

Rami Niranjan Desai

26 October, 2026 12:07 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

I n December 1774, shortly before his death, Prithvi Narayan Shah, the founder of modern Nepal, gathered his family and advisers in Nuwakot. He famously counselled them that his kingdom was like a yam between two boulders. More than two centuries later, Nepal’s understanding of its geography continues to reflect this metaphor.

Over the years, Nepali statecraft has not only been shaped by that image of vulnerability, but successive political leaders have invoked it to stir nationalist sentiments when domestic politics becomes difficult. However, Nepal’s challenge today is no longer simply navigating its position between India and China, but transforming that position into an opportunity for national prosperity.

It is against this backdrop that a statement by Nepal’s Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle assumes particular significance. Speaking at a summit in New Delhi on 23 October, he declared,

Show Full Article

“There was a time when we equated Nepali nationalism with anti-India sentiment. That era is now over.” India and Nepal, he said, are “joined at the hip”, adding that it is “exceptionally important that India rises”.

Coming from a senior minister in Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s RSP-led government, the remark was more than diplomatic courtesy. It signalled an attempt by a new generation of leaders to redefine nationalism around economic opportunity rather than grievance.

A new generation, a different political mandate
Three factors explain the timing of Wagle’s statement. First, the domestic transformation that brought the Balendra Shah-led government to power.

The Gen Z protests in September 2025 were initially driven by social media restrictions but quickly turned into a wider expression of anger against corruption and a loss of faith in a recycled political class. Shah’s government emerged as an alternative to the old style of politics that Nepal had grown accustomed to.

As mayor of Kathmandu, Shah built a following through his no-nonsense approach to governance, which frequently circulated on social media and resonated with the country’s youth.

His rejection of traditional political rhetoric distinguished him from Nepal’s established politicians, particularly among younger voters frustrated by a lack of job opportunities, political instability and corrupt governance.

Shah’s government has therefore centred its promise on reform and employment, priorities that have little to do with hostility towards India.

Economic ties make a case for pragmatism
The second factor is economic realism. India and Nepal have traditionally shared what is often described as roti-beti ka rishta —a relationship sustained across generations through cross-border marriages, education, family ties and local economies.

Approximately 62.3 per cent of Nepal’s merchandise trade is with India, with bilateral trade reaching $9.39 billion in FY 2025–26.

Furthermore, in 2024, the two countries signed a long-term agreement to increase Nepal’s electricity exports to India to 10,000 MW within ten years. This could become a significant source of revenue for Nepal.

Also Read: Balen Shah’s victory signals the fall of Nepal’s old establishment. India will have to adapt

Shah’s first bilateral visit could set the tone
The third factor is Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s first bilateral visit, expected later this year. The much-anticipated visit could build on this shift in political tone and signal that Nepal’s national confidence need not be demonstrated through political distance from New Delhi. Instead, it could be grounded in economic growth and employment.

For India, this is an opportunity to engage with a new generation of Nepali leadership and respond constructively to Wagle’s remarks.

The agenda could include the inauguration of the integrated check post at Bhairahawa, construction of the Dodhara Chandani check post, commencement of the Lower Arun hydropower project, and a petroleum pipeline from Siliguri to Jhapa.

If these projects deliver electricity, revenue, jobs and easier movement of people and goods, both countries could build a stronger foundation for their relationship—one based on substantive cooperation and diplomatic pragmatism rather than confrontation.

Old nationalist fault lines remain
However, the familiar politics of the recent past has not disappeared. Wagle’s remarks have provoked sharp criticism from Nepal’s political opposition. Kamal Thapa, a former deputy prime minister, insisted that “Nepal’s nationalism has never been based on opposition to any particular country”. Gokul Baskota, a former minister from the Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist), dismissed the statement as “intellectual bankruptcy”.

The dialogue between India and Nepal will also have to address difficult issues that go beyond diplomatic symbolism, particularly the territorial dispute over Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura.

India rejected Nepal’s revised political map in 2020. Discussions over the competing territorial claims will require sophisticated diplomatic manoeuvring from both sides.

Kathmandu, meanwhile, will seek more air-entry routes, easier access to Indian markets for its agricultural goods, faster implementation of hydropower projects and progress on the proposed Siliguri–Jhapa petroleum pipeline, among other priorities.

For Shah, the challenge will be delivering tangible economic gains under the scrutiny of an opposition eager to turn any cooperation or compromise into a domestic political controversy.

From concessions to opportunities
Ultimately, the test for Nepal’s new leadership will be whether it can move beyond a political culture that often measures engagement with India by the concessions made rather than the opportunities created.

This is precisely why Wagle’s statement matters. It does not mean that longstanding disputes have disappeared; rather, it suggests that there is more to the relationship than those disputes.

Prithvi Narayan Shah’s metaphor of a yam between two boulders captured Nepal’s anxieties about its geography in a different age and context. If Wagle’s words mark the beginning of a new political reality, the yam between two boulders may finally have outlived its usefulness as Nepal’s defining metaphor.

Rami Niranjan Desai is a Distinguished Fellow at the India Foundation, New Delhi. She tweets @ramindesai.

items.title: Cyclone Arnab: Andhra, Odisha prepare to evacuate people ahead of landfall
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Arnab, which formed over the Bay of Bengal before intensifying into a cyclonic storm, is expected to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh state by Wednesday morning ...
items.body: Two states along India's eastern coast were preparing to evacuate thousands of people ahead of Cyclone Arnab, which is expected to make landfall on Wednesday, as one of them said it would close schools in some districts for two days. Arnab, which formed over the Bay of Bengal before intensifying into a cyclonic storm, is expected to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh state by Wednesday morning, with gusts of as much as 140 kph (87 mph), India's weather office said. The cyclone will probably intensify further, it added. The weather system is expected to bring heavy to extremely heavy rainfall to Andhra Pradesh's northern and central coastal districts, and southern regions of neighbouring Odisha. Andhra Pradesh has called for boats at sea to return ashore and ordered speedy restoration of power in case of disruptions. A senior Andhra Pradesh disaster management official told Reuters on Monday the state government had identified 570,000 people as vulnerable and evacuations would start on Monday evening. Odisha's government announced the closure of schools and colleges in five districts for Tuesday and Wednesday, and said it was preparing to move residents of low-lying areas to cyclone shelters. The Bay of Bengal is one of the world's major regions for tropical cyclones.

items.title: Mekka-Pakt: Spitzenvertreter beraten in Teheran über regionale Sicherheit
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Spitzenvertreter der Mekka-Pakt-Staaten Saudi-Arabien, Türkei und Pakistan werden nach iranischen Angaben im Tagesverlauf zu Beratungen über den Konflikt in Nahost in Teheran erwartet. Der saudiarabische Verteidigungsminister Prinz Chalid bin Salman, Pakistans Armeechef Asim Munir und der türkische Geheimdienstchef Ibrahim Kalin würden zu Konsultationen in die iranische Hauptstadt kommen, teilte der stellvertretende Sekretär des Nationalen Sicherheitsrats der Islamischen Republik, Ali Bagheri Kani, am Montag im Staatsfernsehen mit. Insidern zufolge soll es bei den Gesprächen um die regionale Sicherheitslage gehen. Bestätigungen aus Riad, Islamabad und Ankara lagen zunächst nicht vor. Es wäre der erste hochrangige Kontakt zwischen der Führung in Teheran und dem neuen Verteidigungsbündnis, seit Saudi-Arabien verstärkt von den mit dem Iran verbündeten Huthi-Rebellen aus dem Jemen angegriffen wird.
items.body:
Spitzenvertreter der Mekka-Pakt-Staaten Saudi-Arabien, Türkei und Pakistan werden nach iranischen Angaben im Tagesverlauf zu Beratungen über den Konflikt in Nahost in Teheran erwartet. Der saudiarabische Verteidigungsminister Prinz Chalid bin Salman, Pakistans Armeechef Asim Munir und der türkische Geheimdienstchef Ibrahim Kalin würden zu Konsultationen in die iranische Hauptstadt kommen, teilte der stellvertretende Sekretär des Nationalen Sicherheitsrats der Islamischen Republik, Ali Bagheri Kani, am Montag im Staatsfernsehen mit. Insidern zufolge soll es bei den Gesprächen um die regionale Sicherheitslage gehen. Bestätigungen aus Riad, Islamabad und Ankara lagen zunächst nicht vor. Es wäre der erste hochrangige Kontakt zwischen der Führung in Teheran und dem neuen Verteidigungsbündnis, seit Saudi-Arabien verstärkt von den mit dem Iran verbündeten Huthi-Rebellen aus dem Jemen angegriffen wird.
Am Sonntag fing die saudiarabische Luftabwehr eine weitere Welle von Raketen und Drohnen ab. Die Verteidigungsminister des Mekka-Pakts hatten bei einem Dringlichkeitstreffen in Riad Anfang des Monats vereinbart, Truppen und militärische Ausrüstung rasch nach Saudi-Arabien zu verlegen. Das im August geschlossene Verteidigungsbündnis sieht vor, dass ein bewaffneter Angriff auf ein Mitglied als Angriff auf alle drei Mitglieder gewertet wird. Pakistan nimmt zudem in dem Konflikt eine Vermittlerrolle zwischen den USA und dem Iran ein.

items.title: Entwurf: Finanzministerium bringt neues Geldwäschegesetz auf den Weg
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die Bundesregierung bringt die Umsetzung von EU-Vorgaben zur stärkeren Bekämpfung von Geldwäsche auf den Weg. Die EU-Pläne sollen dabei eins zu eins umgesetzt werden, wie aus einem der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Montag vorliegenden Referentenentwurf des Finanzministeriums hervorgeht. Dieser wird derzeit regierungsintern beraten. Die Maßnahmen ergänzen den bereits vorgestellten Aktionsplan der Bundesregierung gegen Steuer- und Finanzkriminalität.
items.body:
Die Bundesregierung bringt die Umsetzung von EU-Vorgaben zur stärkeren Bekämpfung von Geldwäsche auf den Weg. Die EU-Pläne sollen dabei eins zu eins umgesetzt werden, wie aus einem der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Montag vorliegenden Referentenentwurf des Finanzministeriums hervorgeht. Dieser wird derzeit regierungsintern beraten. Die Maßnahmen ergänzen den bereits vorgestellten [USN:L8N43I18N TEXT:"Aktionsplan"] der Bundesregierung gegen Steuer- und Finanzkriminalität.
Das Bundeskriminalamt beziffert den für 2025 durch Geldwäsche verursachten Schaden auf 1,5 Milliarden Euro. Die tatsächliche Summe dürfte allerdings deutlich höher liegen. In der Regierung heißt es, es gebe den Trend, dass Geldwäsche immer professioneller und digitaler werde, was die ohnehin komplexen und oft internationalen Ermittlungen erschwere.
Das SPD-geführte Finanzministerium will das bestehende Geldwäschegesetz aus dem Jahr 2017 zum 10. Juli 2027 aufheben. Es soll dann durch ein neues Gesetz zur Bekämpfung von Geldwäsche und Terrorismusfinanzierung ersetzt werden. Außerdem werden noch Anpassungen des Kreditwesengesetzes und des Bundeskriminalamtgesetzes vorgenommen.
Konkret geplant ist, eine zentrale Koordinierungsstelle für die Geldwäscheaufsicht bei der Bonner BaFin einzurichten. Außerdem soll die Zentralstelle für Finanztransaktionsuntersuchungen (FIU) mehr Befugnisse bekommen. Vorgesehen ist auch mehr Transparenz, wer hinter Firmen, Organisationen oder Stiftungen steht. Ab Juli 2029 soll dann eine zentrale Zugangsstelle für Immobilieninformationen stehen. Sie soll auch zu mehr Transparenz führen, insbesondere für Strafverfolgungsbehörden. Ferner werden Abrufverfahren zu Bankkonten europaweit besser vernetzt.
Hintergrund des Gesetzentwurfes ist das EU-Paket zur Geldwäschebekämpfung von Ende Mai 2024. Es ist die bisher weitreichendste Reform im Bereich der Geldwäscheprävention und umfasst zwei Richtlinien sowie zwei Verordnungen. Es muss in den 27 EU-Staaten ab dem 10. Juli 2027 angewendet werden. Es regelt unter anderem, welche Unternehmen Präventionsmaßnahmen gegen Geldwäsche ergreifen müssen, etwa durch Prüfung der Identität eines Kunden oder die Meldung von Verdachtsfällen. Außerdem wird eine EU-weite Obergrenze für Bargeldzahlungen von 10.000 Euro im gewerblichen Bereich eingeführt. Diese gilt jedoch nicht für Geschäfte zwischen Privatpersonen.
Durch das von der Bundesregierung geplante Gesetz entstehen im Bundeshaushalt in den Jahren 2027 bis 2030 zusätzliche Ausgaben in Höhe von insgesamt rund 157 Millionen Euro. Bei der Finanzaufsichtsbehöre BaFin sollen 32 zusätzliche Vollzeitstellen geschaffen werden, um die neuen Aufgaben zu erfüllen. Insidern zufolge soll das Kabinett noch in diesem Jahr grünes Licht für das Gesetz geben.

items.creator: Sherin Sunny, Nikita Jino
items.summary: Australia's CSL on Monday named interim chief Gordon Naylor as chair from March next year, the latest leadership shake-up days after naming GSK executive Deborah Waterhourse as its first female CEO.
items.body:
Australia's CSL (CSL.AX) on Monday named interim chief Gordon Naylor as chair from March next year, the latest leadership shake-up days after naming GSK (GSK.L) executive Deborah Waterhourse as its first female CEO.
Naylor has led CSL on an interim basis since February, following the surprise exit of former CEO Paul McKenzie amid investor concerns over the biotechnology giant's falling shares.
Once Australia's most valuable listed company and a market favourite, CSL suffered a series of earnings and revenue downgrades and announced plans to cut 3,000 jobs, triggering selloffs that wiped billions of dollars from its market value over the past year.
"CSL's leadership picture is finally coming into focus, and Gordon Naylor's elevation to chair provides continuity at a critical juncture," said Marc Jocum, senior ETF strategist at Global X ETFs.
Naylor's role in CSL's strategic reset and his knowledge of the company should help [USN:L4N4670C7 TEXT:"incoming CEO Deborah Waterhouse"] tackle its challenges, combining new executive leadership with an experienced chair, he added.
Current chair Brian McNamee will retire from CSL's board on March 31, 2027, after more than eight years in the role. He previously served as CEO and managing director from 1990 to 2013.
CSL shares closed 0.8% lower at A$195.14, broadly in line with a 0.5% decline in the healthcare sub-index (.AXHJ) .

items.title: ヨルダン教会襲撃で容疑者3人逮捕、銃撃戦の末　死者9人に＝国営メディア
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yomna Ehab

[２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Yomna Ehab

[２６日 ロイター] - ヨルダンの治安部隊は２６日、９人が死亡した教会襲撃事件に関連したみられる武装した容疑者３人を銃撃戦の末に逮捕した。国営テレビが報じた。

この事件は２３日、首都アンマンの南西約１２０キロにあるカラク県ハムード村のギリシャ正教会で葬儀中に発生し、ほかにも４０人が負傷した。目撃者によると、銃撃は数分間続いたという。

公安当局は国営メディアを通じて発表した声明で、カラクの廃屋に潜伏していた容疑者らを発見したと説明。容疑者らは投降を拒否して治安部隊を攻撃したため、部隊が応戦し、３人全員を負傷させた上で逮捕した。

ヨルダン当局は「過激派テロリスト」による犯行としている。犯行声明は出ていない。

イスラム過激派組織との戦いで米国と協力するアブドラ国王は、少数派のキリスト教徒を狙った襲撃事件を巡り「断固たる措置」を取るよう治安部隊に命じた。

中東で比較的安定しているヨルダンでは、こうした暴力事件は極めて異例。ただ、当局はこれまでにイスラム過激派による複数の計画を阻止したとしている。

公安当局は容疑者の氏名や、イスラム過激派組織とのつながりの可能性について公表していない。

items.title: Ukraine-Des frappes russes visent plusieurs régions, des blessés
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Des frappes russes menées dans la nuit de dimanche à lundi ont fait six blessés dans le sud-est et le nord de l'Ukraine, ont dit un responsable et les services d'urgence ukrainiens.
items.body:
Des frappes russes menées dans la nuit de dimanche à lundi ont fait six blessés dans le sud-est et le nord de l'Ukraine, ont dit un responsable et les services d'urgence ukrainiens.
Quatre personnes ont été blessées dans la ville de Zaporijjia, a dit lundi le gouverneur de cette région du sud-est, Mykhaïlo Semikine, sur Telegram.
Les services d'urgence ukrainiens ont par ailleurs indiqué que deux personnes avaient été blessées dans la région de Tchernihiv, dans le nord du pays.
Le ministère russe de la Défense a de son côté annoncé avoir frappé une centrale électrique à Kharkiv, la deuxième ville d'Ukraine, et une autre dans la région de Khmelnitskiy, dans l'ouest du pays.
Des infrastructures portuaires à Tchornomorsk et un navire cargo qui faisait route vers Odessa utilisé à des fins militaires, ont également été pris pour cible, a dit le ministère.

items.title: South African rand steady with local economic data, Fed decision in focus
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The South African rand was steady in early trade on Monday as investors awaited a series of domestic economic data releases and the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
items.body:
The South African rand was steady in early trade on Monday as investors awaited a series of domestic economic data releases and the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
At 0602 GMT, the rand traded at 16.6125 against the dollar , little changed from its previous close
Investors will track a series of month-end domestic economic data releases, including money supply (ZAM3=ECI) , private sector credit (ZACRED=ECI) , trade balance (ZATBAL=ECI) and budget balance (ZABUD=ECI) , as well as September producer inflation (ZAPPI=ECI) data
Markets also await the Fed's policy meeting on October 28. Traders largely expect the central bank to leave rates unchanged this week, while expectations for a hike in December are at 75%, according to CME's FedWatch Tool
Like other risk-sensitive currencies, the rand often takes its cues from global factors, particularly US monetary policy, alongside domestic economic data
South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond was steady in early deals, with the yield at 8.635%

items.title: Jordan arrests three suspects in deadly church attack
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church on Friday, killing nine people and wounding 40 others.
items.body:

Jordan arrests three suspects in deadly church attack

Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church on Friday, killing nine people and wounding 40 others.

A hearse with the coffin of a victim of a church shooting, in Karak, Jordan, Oct 25, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Alaa Al Sukhni)

FAST

Jordanian security forces have arrested three suspects in connection with an attack on a church in the US-allied country that killed nine people, state television reported on Monday (Oct 26). 
The attack, in which gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church on Friday in the village of Hamoud in Karak governorate, about 120 km southwest of the capital Amman, also wounded 40 others. The shooting lasted several minutes, witnesses said.
Jordan's Public Security Directorate said security forces located the three suspects early on Monday hiding in an abandoned house in Karak. The suspects refused to surrender and opened fire on security forces, who returned fire and arrested all three after they were wounded, the directorate said in a statement carried on state media.
No security personnel were injured, and a number of firearms and ammunition were found in the suspects' possession after their arrest.
"Terrorism has no place among us," the directorate said, adding that the suspects had met their "just fate".
The Public Security Directorate did not identify the suspects' affiliation or say whether they belonged to any militant group.

The grounds of Saint George’s Greek Orthodox Church, where gunmen opened fire during a funeral the previous day, is cordoned-off, in the village of Hamoud, Karak, Jordan, October 24, 2026. REUTERS/Alaa Al Sukhni

Jordanian authorities have said the attack was carried out by "extremist terrorists", but it was too early to determine whether they had links to known groups inside or outside Jordan. There has been no claim of responsibility.
Interior Minister Mazen al-Faraya said on Monday authorities were reviewing the circumstances that led young people towards extremism and would hold accountable anyone found to have participated in the attack.
King Abdullah, a US partner in the fight against Islamist militant groups, has ordered security forces to respond with an "iron fist" to the rare attack on Jordan's Christian minority.
Such violence is highly unusual in Jordan, a relatively stable state in the Middle East, though authorities say they have foiled several Islamist militant plots over the years.

Related:

Singapore leaders condemn deadly church attack in Jordan, convey condolences to victims' families

Source: Reuters/aj

items.title: Revolut launches personal loans in UK, taking on major banks
items.author: Lawrence White, Tommy Wilkes
items.creator: Lawrence White, Tommy Wilkes
items.summary: Digital bank Revolut has begun offering unsecured personal loans in Britain, its UK chief executive Francesca Carlesi told Reuters, taking Europe's most valuable startup into a lucrative consumer lending market dominated by the country's biggest banks.
items.body:
Digital bank Revolut has begun offering unsecured personal loans in Britain, its UK chief executive Francesca Carlesi told Reuters, taking Europe's most valuable startup into a lucrative consumer lending market dominated by the country's biggest banks.
The move pushes Revolut beyond its core payments and subscription products and into a riskier business as it seeks to compete more directly with lenders including NatWest (NWG.L) , Lloyds (LLOY.L) , Barclays (BARC.L) , Santander's (SAN.MC) UK business and HSBC (HSBA.L) .
"We want to transition from being a very successful everyday spending app and disrupting the market, to become effectively the primary bank of choice for everybody in the UK," Carlesi said.
Revolut will also launch a credit card product in the near future, Carlesi said, part of a broader effort to increase the income it generates from each customer, a metric by which it lags traditional banks.
Since its creation in 2015 by CEO Nik Storonsky and Vlad Yatsenko, London-based Revolut has grown worldwide to serve more than 80 million customers and commands a private valuation of $115 billion, bigger than listed rivals like Barclays and NatWest.
Yet the bank still [USN:L6N45R0BS TEXT:"faces questions over whether it can sustain its breakneck growth"] with per-customer revenue well below rivals along with the proportion of its customers using Revolut for their primary bank account and paying salaries in.
Revolut's rapid growth has also drawn regulatory and operational scrutiny. In 2025, Lithuania's central bank imposed a record €3.5 million fine over shortcomings in transaction-monitoring controls, while this month it was among financial firms hit by an hours-long [USN:L6N4660L6 TEXT:"Google Cloud outage"].
OFFLOADING THE RISK While Revolut already offers unsecured loans in some other countries, Britain is one of its biggest markets.
Carlesi said Revolut will initially take a cautious approach, offering loans to a selected group of customers and expanding to its 14 million customers in Britain over the coming months.
The loans will range from £2,000 to £25,000, with rates of 6.9% to 29.3%, a Revolut spokesperson said.
Without the decades of customer spending and repayment data held by traditional banks, Revolut has supplemented its underwriting with information purchased from external providers, Carlesi said, adding that the company was confident about its credit analysis.
Revolut will expand lending gradually and does not have a target for its overall lending in Britain, Carlesi said.
The bank will eventually look to offload much of its risk via securitisation, aiming to keep its loan-to-deposit ratio close to 6%, far lower than other banks, she said.
Carlesi said Revolut also eventually plans to enter the highly competitive market for mortgages in Britain.
Revolut's lending push comes amid persistent cost-of-living challenges in Britain worsened by a [USN:L8N46608R TEXT:"soft labour market"] and rising inflation, which could weigh on borrowers' ability to repay debt.

items.title: Who are the leading candidates in Israel's election?
items.author: Maayan Lubell
items.creator: Maayan Lubell
items.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has long looked on course to lose power in Israel's election, but the race has narrowed as the vote approaches and his rivals have no clear path to power.
items.body:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has long looked on course to lose power in Israel's election, but the race has narrowed as the vote approaches and his rivals have no clear path to power.
Votes will be cast on Tuesday for parties, and seats in parliament will be allocated to individuals on party lists according to proportional representation.
Here are details of some of the leading candidates in Israel's first parliamentary election since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023 that plunged the Middle East into turmoil, with Israel going to war in Lebanon and Gaza and launching airstrikes against Iran.
BENJAMIN NETANYAHU In power for much of the time since 2009, after a first stint as prime minister in the 1990s, Netanyahu has become the face of Israel abroad and a polarising figure at home.
Supporters hail Netanyahu as "King Bibi" and see him as the strong leader Israel needs to defend itself in a hostile region. But, wanted by the International Criminal Court over alleged war crimes in Gaza which he rejects and on trial in Israel on corruption charges which he denies, he is fighting for his political life.
Opinion polls have pointed to a sharp drop for his Likud party since the October 7 attack, which shattered Netanyahu's security credentials. His government's policies on matters of religion and state have also been unpopular among many Israelis.
But Netanyahu, 77, is a consummate political survivor. He has said he wants to form a "broad national" government after the election, if he wins. In the event of a stalemate, he could remain a caretaker prime minister for many months.
NETANYAHU'S TOP RIVALS * Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, who lost a son in Gaza combat. Eisenkot, 66, has projected an image as a political outsider, soldier and security hawk whose humble background and family sacrifices stand in vivid contrast to Netanyahu's decades in high office and lingering corruption cases. He heads a new centrist party called Yashar, Hebrew for "straight" or "honest".
* Former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett, 54, a right-wing former commando, former Netanyahu aide and high-tech millionaire who has joined forces with centrist former premier Yair Lapid. Their new party is called Together and its messages have focused on healing a traumatised nation and getting the country back on track. Their alliance, despite being on opposite ends of the political spectrum, ousted Netanyahu in a 2021 election.
* Former Defence Minister Avigdor Lieberman, 68, was once a close ally of Netanyahu. Even more hawkish than his former boss, Lieberman quit Netanyahu's government in 2018, accusing the prime minister of being too soft on Palestinian militants in Gaza, and has become one of Netanyahu's sharpest critics. His party, Israel Our Home, draws much of its support from the country's ex-Soviet immigrant community.
* Former general Yair Golan, 64, hailed for his rescue of people from one of the Hamas October 7 attack sites, leads the Democrats, founded on the moribund remnants of Israel's historical Labour party and smaller left-wing Meretz.
CANDIDATES ON NETANYAHU'S SIDE Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, 46, and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, 50, have both drawn intense international scrutiny for their far-right policies toward the Palestinians.
Smotrich has spearheaded Israel's rapid expansion of West Bank settlements, voicing his hope that it would 'bury' the idea of a Palestinian state.
Ben-Gvir, who was convicted in 2007 of racist incitement against Arabs, has promoted capital punishment for convicted Palestinian militants, toughened prison conditions for jailed Palestinians and easier gun ownership for Israelis.
Both men have advocated for the expulsion of Palestinians from the Gaza Strip and Israel resettling the enclave.
ULTRA-ORTHODOX ALLIES Netanyahu has relied on two ultra-Orthodox Jewish parties, United Torah Judaism and Shas, for his political survival for years. Their demands for their community to be mostly exempt from compulsory military service, along with their low participation in the work force and reliance on state benefits, have angered many Israelis, all the more so at a time of war.
POTENTIAL KEY PLAYERS Parties which are not clearly aligned with either side could tip the balance in favour of Netanyahu or his rivals. They include Raam and the Joint List, the two parties that represent Israel's 20% Arab minority. Along with them are a new right-wing party called People of Israel and a centre-right party called The Reservists, both of which have been wavering in opinion polls.

items.title: インフォシス株下落、増収率引き下げを嫌気　ＡＩ価格圧力など重し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mridula Kumar　Sai Ishwarbharath B

[２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Mridula Kumar　Sai Ishwarbharath B

[２６日 ロイター] - インド株式市場でＩＴ（情報技術）サービス大手のインフォシスが２．７％下落。２３日の業績発表で２０２７年３月期の増収率予想を大幅に引き下げたことを嫌気している。人工知能（ＡＩ）に伴う価格下押し圧力や競争激化、主要市場の需要低迷という課題が浮き彫りになった。

インドのＩＴ大手５社のうち最後の決算発表だった。今月これに先立ち発表した同業のタタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）とＨＣＬテックは、売上高が市場予想に一致した。利益率の動向は目立ったものではなかったが、市場はＡＩ関連売上高の増加を好感した。

インフォシスは２７年３月期の増収率予想を従来の１．５─３％から１─２％に引き下げた。アナリストの大半は、予想レンジの上限を２．５％に引き下げると見込んでいた。

ＬＫＰセキュリティーズのアナリスト、アンシュル・ジェティ氏は「現時点では同業他社の方がインフォシスより有利な立場にあり、株価の動きはそれを反映しているにすぎない。インフォシス株は２６年度第４・四半期決算の発表以降、低調に推移している」と述べた。

同氏によると、ＡＩを巡る競争に加え、顧客がインフォシスにＩＴサービスを委託せず、グローバル・ケイパビリティー・センターと呼ばれる自社の海外業務拠点や海外の技術拠点を直接拡充していることも同社の逆風となっている。

システマティックスのアナリストは「失望を誘う四半期決算」と評価。競争激化や、ＡＩ活用に伴う顧客の生産性向上要求による価格下押し圧力、小売り・ハイテク分野の顧客による技術投資の低迷を指摘した。

証券会社モティラル・オズワルは、業務量の減少、想定を下回る値上げ、海外拠点からのサービス提供への移行に加え、欧州製造業の大口契約からの撤退というインフォシスの決定が成長の重しになったと分析した。

ＴＤカウエンは、マクロ経済の不確実性、ＡＩによる生産性向上への要求、競争激化が価格と業務量に悪影響を与えたと指摘。季節的な低迷と顧客の業務縮小が下半期の成長を圧迫する可能性があるとした。

items.body:
インフォシス株下落、増収率引き下げを嫌気　ＡＩ価格圧力など重し
15:01 配信

写真はインフォシスのロゴ。7月23日、インドのベンガルールで撮影。 REUTERS/Priyanshu Singh

Mridula Kumar　Sai Ishwarbharath B

[２６日 ロイター] - インド株式市場でＩＴ（情報技術）サービス大手のインフォシスが２．７％下落。２３日の業績発表で２０２７年３月期の増収率予想を大幅に引き下げたことを嫌気している。人工知能（ＡＩ）に伴う価格下押し圧力や競争激化、主要市場の需要低迷という課題が浮き彫りになった。

インドのＩＴ大手５社のうち最後の決算発表だった。今月これに先立ち発表した同業のタタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）とＨＣＬテックは、売上高が市場予想に一致した。利益率の動向は目立ったものではなかったが、市場はＡＩ関連売上高の増加を好感した。

インフォシスは２７年３月期の増収率予想を従来の１．５─３％から１─２％に引き下げた。アナリストの大半は、予想レンジの上限を２．５％に引き下げると見込んでいた。

ＬＫＰセキュリティーズのアナリスト、アンシュル・ジェティ氏は「現時点では同業他社の方がインフォシスより有利な立場にあり、株価の動きはそれを反映しているにすぎない。インフォシス株は２６年度第４・四半期決算の発表以降、低調に推移している」と述べた。

同氏によると、ＡＩを巡る競争に加え、顧客がインフォシスにＩＴサービスを委託せず、グローバル・ケイパビリティー・センターと呼ばれる自社の海外業務拠点や海外の技術拠点を直接拡充していることも同社の逆風となっている。

システマティックスのアナリストは「失望を誘う四半期決算」と評価。競争激化や、ＡＩ活用に伴う顧客の生産性向上要求による価格下押し圧力、小売り・ハイテク分野の顧客による技術投資の低迷を指摘した。

証券会社モティラル・オズワルは、業務量の減少、想定を下回る値上げ、海外拠点からのサービス提供への移行に加え、欧州製造業の大口契約からの撤退というインフォシスの決定が成長の重しになったと分析した。

ＴＤカウエンは、マクロ経済の不確実性、ＡＩによる生産性向上への要求、競争激化が価格と業務量に悪影響を与えたと指摘。季節的な低迷と顧客の業務縮小が下半期の成長を圧迫する可能性があるとした。

ＬＳＥＧがまとめたデータによると、アナリストの投資判断は平均で「買い」、目標株価の中央値は１１８０ルピーとなっている。

インド時間午前１０時５３分（日本時間午後２時２３分）時点で、インフォシス株は１．５％安の１１３６ルピー。ニフティＩＴ指数は０．２％下落する一方、主要株価指数のＮＳＥ（ニフティ５０）指数は０．１６％上昇した。

items.title: China says no secondary disasters, casualties from Tibet earthquake
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China said on Monday there had been no secondary geological disasters and no further casualties from a magnitude-7 earthquake that struck China's southwestern region of Tibet last Friday, killing 16 people and injuring 76.
items.body:
China said on Monday there had been no secondary geological disasters and no further casualties from a magnitude-7 [USN:L6N4690I3 TEXT:"earthquake"] that struck China's southwestern region of Tibet last Friday, killing 16 people and injuring 76.
The country's Ministry of Natural Resources said in a statement that the "impact of this earthquake on glacier lakes and glaciers within the affected area was generally minimal"
Since the earthquake there have been a total of 2,054 aftershocks, including two of at least 5.0 magnitude
Authorities completed inspections of secondary geological disasters within a 50 km (31 miles) radius of the epicentre
The [USN:L1N4680UK TEXT:"quake"] struck Nagqu, a high-altitude city in northern Tibet, a sparsely populated region of China, and was the strongest to hit the country since January 2024
Authorities inspected 157 geological disaster hazard points, including 122 existing hazards and 35 new hazard points, the ministry said. Experts analysed 80 glacial lakes and 145 glaciers within a 50-km radius of the earthquake, they said

items.title: North Korea-South Korea tensions high as letters lodged with UN, howitzer spotted
items.author: CNA
items.summary: North Korea has put a howitzer on rare public display near its border with South Korea, in what an expert says is a warning that Pyongyang is prepared to use force to enforce its border policy.

North Korea-South Korea tensions high as letters lodged with UN, howitzer spotted

North Korea has put a howitzer on rare public display near its border with South Korea, in what an expert says is a warning that Pyongyang is prepared to use force to enforce its border policy.

North Korean soldiers work on their military fence at their border, as seen from an observation deck in Gimpo, South Korea, on Oct 26, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Kim Hong-Ji)

SEOUL: Tensions between North Korea and South Korea are running high this week after Pyongyang sent a letter to the UN Security Council, repeating accusations that Seoul fabricated a September landmine incident, and after a North Korean howitzer was spotted close to the border.
A Reuters witness at an observatory in South Korea overlooking the heavily armed border on Monday (Oct 26) confirmed the presence of a North Korean artillery piece positioned in clear view near the frontier.
South Korea's Yonhap news agency on Sunday identified the weapon as a self-propelled 122mm howitzer, saying its deployment near the border marked a rare public display of such artillery.
Reuters also observed three North Korean armoured vehicles with their gun barrels pointed south, as well as about 20 to 30 North Korean soldiers carrying out fencing work inside the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ).

"It is highly unusual (for North Korea) to expose its self-propelled artillery so conspicuously,” said Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University in Seoul.
"By deliberately displaying it, North Korea is signalling through action, not words, that it intends to enforce its border policy through force rather than dialogue or negotiation."
It is also warning South Korea to exercise caution about escalating border friction, with the intention to prevent an accidental clash, he added.

North Korean self-propelled 122-mm howitzers are deployed at their border as seen from an observation deck in Gimpo, South Korea, on Oct 26, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Kim Hong-Ji)

North Korean state media KCNA reported that in the letter sent on Sunday, the country's UN representative said Seoul was using the landmine incident to depict Pyongyang's border construction as a military incursion.
North Korea warned in the letter that violations of its sovereignty could trigger self-defence measures and that South Korea would be "wholly accountable for all the ensuing consequences".
PHOTOS ALSO SHOW NORTH KOREAN DRILLS The letter is a response to a South Korean letter to the Security Council last week, which said a Sep 21 blast in the DMZ was planted by North Korean troops and constituted a violation of the Korean War Armistice Agreement.
The UN Command, which oversees the DMZ, has said a North Korean mine across the line violated the armistice. Pyongyang has denied responsibility.
A spokesperson for South Korea's Unification Ministry said on Monday that the North Korean letter appears to repeat North Korea's existing position and seeks to justify its so-called border line marking work.
The ministry had no separate comment on the placement of the howitzer. Seoul has proposed dialogue with North Korea to defuse border tensions.

Related:

Kim Jong Un tells North Korean army units to prepare for 'new-era military build-up'

North Korea's Kim returns home after visit to Chinese border city

North Korea's letter also repeated accusations that South Korea had opened fire on North Korean personnel, calling that a violation of the UN Charter, which bars the threat or use of force against another state's territorial integrity.
Seoul has said its military issues warning broadcasts and fires warning shots to send North Korean soldiers back across the line when they cross the military demarcation line (MDL), which bisects the DMZ.
North Korean troops have been building tactical roads and fences and laying mines near the MDL in recent years.
The Yonhap report cited photographs taken from an observatory in the South Korean border city of Gimpo that appeared to show the howitzer as well as North Korean troops conducting drills on the coast of Kaepung county, about 1.5km from the observatory.
In 2015, there was a similar incident in which South Korean troops were injured by North Korean mines. Then, Seoul resumed anti-North Korea loudspeaker broadcasts across the DMZ, triggering a military standoff. After North Korea expressed regret, the standoff ended with a high-level inter-Korean agreement.

Brazil nips Latin America’s Trump tide with dramatic win for Lula: ‘Nobody’s backyard’

Trump ally Flávio Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat—much like his father and former Brazil President Jair Bolsonaro in 2022—and is seeking to annul the runoff. 

Debdutta Chakraborty

26 October, 2026 11:26 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva received 51.78% of votes against Bolsonaro’s 48.22% in Sunday’s run-off | Credit: Thomson Reuters 2026

New Delhi: For Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the incumbent president of Brazil, political comebacks are usual business. After a month of multiple political obituaries, the 80-year-old staged another stunning comeback Monday, defying projections to defeat Flávio Bolsonaro, the 45-year-old senator and son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, to secure an unprecedented fourth presidential term. No other candidate in Brazilian presidential elections has ever won a runoff after losing the first round.

With his victory, Brazil has staved off the conservative wave in Latin America that has seen Colombia, Peru, Argentina and Chile bring in right-wing governments—all with the backing of US President Donald Trump. In his winning speech, taking an apparent dig at Trump, Lula declared, “ This country does not accept being anybody’s backyard.”

Prime Minister Narendra Modi was among the leaders who congratulated Lula as his victory became evident, referring to him as “my dear friend”. “Look forward to working closely with him to further deepen and expand the multifaceted India-Brazil Strategic Partnership,” he wrote on X. “Together, we will continue to strengthen our cooperation across diverse sectors, advance the shared priorities of the Global South and work towards a more inclusive, equitable and sustainable world.”

Show Full Article

Lula received 51.78 per cent of the vote against Bolsonaro’s 48.22 per cent in Sunday’s runoff, the second round of voting after an inconclusive first . Bolsonaro had emerged ahead in the first round, held on 4 October, with 47.03 per cent of valid votes against Lula’s 45.16 per cent. Neither candidate won over 50 per cent of the vote, forcing a runoff that cast doubt on Lula’s political future. While he lost the first round by around 2.2 million votes, by the end of the runoff, he had won by roughly 4.3 million. 

Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat—much like his father in 2022—and is seeking to annul the runoff. He has criticised a decision by the Supreme Court to extend voting by two hours across the country. “Lula’s campaign had requested the extension, citing difficulties transporting voters to polling stations in several states. Bolsonaro’s campaign had also sought extra voting time, but only in municipalities across five states, citing heavy rain, flooding and power outages,” DW reported.

Also Read: Lula in dead heat with Flávio Bolsonaro as Brazil prepares to elect next president: What’s at stake 

A political career built on comebacks
Lula worked in a factory before becoming a union leader in São Paulo in the late 1970s. He helped establish the Workers’ Party in 1980 and became one of the most recognisable figures of Brazil’s democratic transition over that decade.

His first three presidential campaigns, in 1989, 1994 and 1998, ended in defeat. In 2002, he finally won the presidency and secured re-election in 2006. He left office in 2010 after completing the two consecutive terms permitted by the constitution.

He was then imprisoned over corruption charges but Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court ruled that the federal court in Curitiba lacked jurisdiction to hear the relevant cases, invalidating its decisions and restoring his eligibility to contest elections.

In 2022, he defeated Jair Bolsonaro, then the incumbent president. The latter was subsequently convicted over a plot to overturn the result of the election and sentenced to 27 years in prison.

Lula’s fourth term is possible because Brazil restricts consecutive presidential terms rather than imposing a lifetime limit of two. A president may serve two consecutive terms and seek the same office again after an interruption. 

Lula’s latest victory comes just before his 81st birthday Tuesday. His inauguration is scheduled for 5 January 2027.

At 80, Lula has presented his victory as something larger than personal political survival. “I always think God has been very generous to me,” he said in his victory statement. “And why was I chosen by God?” he asked, before declaring his belief that God’s finger had always been on his head.

The religious language was also politically significant. For the first time in Brazil’s history, evangelical Christians account for more than a quarter of the population, according to census figures released in June 2025. Data from the 2022 census, published by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics, counted 47.4 million evangelicals, or 26.9 per cent of Brazilians aged 10 and older, up from 21.6 per cent in 2010.

The figures include Pentecostals and other Protestant groups, an increasingly important constituency in Brazilian politics, particularly for the conservative right. 

Also Read: Brazil’s Bolsonaro, Lula spar in first debate as personal attacks fly

Economy and foreign policy
Lula’s return to office will be accompanied by expectations that extend well beyond electoral symbolism. Brazil faces persistent questions about public debt, fiscal credibility, investment and economic growth. The Atlantic Council’s pre-election analysis placed public debt above 80 per cent of gross domestic product and estimated annual fiscal deficits at almost 9 per cent of GDP. 

A Lula government is likely to favour a more gradual fiscal adjustment, preserving room for public investment and social programmes while attempting to maintain a credible framework for managing debt, the analysis noted. Its challenge will be to persuade financial markets that the approach is sufficiently ambitious to stabilise the debt trajectory, it added.

Lula must also contend with a Congress in which right-wing and centre-right parties have strengthened their position. Trade agreements and other commitments requiring legislative approval will depend on negotiations with lawmakers whose political preferences may differ sharply from those of the president.

The result is a familiar tension in Brazilian politics: a president elected on a promise of change, but required to govern through compromise.

The most consequential implications of Lula’s victory may emerge beyond Brazil’s borders. Brazil’s relationship with the United States will remain important regardless of Lula’s political preferences. The same is true of China, which has become Brazil’s largest trading partner. During the campaign, Lula criticised the implications of greater American involvement in Brazil’s critical minerals sector. Bolsonaro, meanwhile, defended closer intelligence-sharing and security cooperation with Washington. Lula has emphasised strategic autonomy, diversified partnerships and multilateral diplomacy. 

During Lula’s first two terms, Brazil sought to transform its economic weight and diplomatic reach into a greater role in global governance. Lula and his foreign minister, Celso Amorim, shifted the emphasis of Brazilian foreign policy away from an overwhelmingly North-South orientation towards South-South cooperation.

Internationally, Brazil expanded its engagement with African countries and helped establish BRICS alongside Russia, India, China and South Africa. 

Brazil also worked with India and South Africa through the IBSA (India, Brazil, South Africa) dialogue forum, which seeks to promote cooperation among the three democracies and develop a shared agenda for addressing poverty and other development challenges. His government also repeatedly called for reform of the United Nations Security Council, seeking a permanent seat for Brazil. Its ambitions aligned with those of Germany, Japan and India, bringing the four countries together in the G4 initiative.

Brazil is a major producer of agricultural commodities, energy, minerals and manufactured goods. Its exports to China provide a substantial economic foundation that neither a new government nor a change in diplomatic tone can easily replace.

Also Read: India’s Modi speaks to Brazil’s Lula on strategic partnership

Why it matters for India
For India, Lula’s victory offers an opportunity that extends beyond the return of a familiar political ally.

Brazil and India have long shared an interest in reforming global governance, expanding the influence of emerging economies and preserving room for independent foreign policy. Yet their relationship has never approached the intensity of either country’s ties with its largest trading partners.

That could change under Lula’s renewed presidency, particularly if Brasilia and New Delhi make greater use of their overlapping interests in BRICS, IBSA and the G20.

Like Brazil, India too seeks to balance close relations with the United States and other regional partners, including through the Quad, while maintaining its longstanding relationship with Russia. Brazil, meanwhile, has historically sought to mitigate American influence in South America while expanding its international partnerships.

Neither country wants to be forced into a choice between Washington and Beijing, or between the Western alliance and Russia.

There is also a strong economic case for a deeper relationship. India is seeking to diversify its international partnerships while managing its geopolitical rivalry with China. Brazil, for its part, is aware of the risks created by its heavy dependence on commodity exports to China and its need for greater foreign investment.

During the campaign, Lula emphasised his desire to travel abroad to encourage investment in Brazil. India could be an important destination for that effort.

Stronger commercial ties would also offer benefits beyond the immediate value of trade. They could help both countries reduce vulnerabilities arising from excessive dependence on a small number of partners, while providing a firmer economic foundation for their diplomatic cooperation.

(Edited by Sunanda Ranjan)

items.title: Gold gains on softer oil prices; Fed decision in focus
items.author: Sukanya Mitra
items.creator: Sukanya Mitra
items.summary: Gold edged higher on Monday as softer oil prices tempered inflation concerns, while investors awaited the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
items.body:
Gold edged higher on Monday as softer oil prices tempered inflation concerns, while investors awaited the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
Spot gold rose 0.4% to $4,010.51 per ounce by 0544 GMT, after hitting its lowest level since mid-July in the previous session. Bullion posted a 4% weekly fall on Friday, its steepest weekly decline since June.
US gold futures for December delivery gained 0.4% to $4,024.00.
"The jump that we've seen is mostly symptomatic of the kind of relief provided by a lower oil price, but one that could easily be capped as markets position for the FOMC decision in a couple of days' time," said Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com.
"Gold will continue to trade as a function of interest rate expectations and geopolitical risks."
Oil prices [USN:L2N46B09G TEXT:"fell"] on Monday after surging to near six-month highs last week, amid hopes of easing hostilities between the United States and Iran, although ongoing attacks on [USN:L2N46A05D TEXT:"Saudi Arabia"] by Yemen's Houthis kept supply concerns in focus.
[USN:S8N43E021 TEXT:"Qatari mediators"] were in Tehran on Sunday to help de-escalate regional tensions in coordination with the United States, an official briefed on the situation told Reuters.
Markets await the Fed's policy meeting on October 27-28.
The US Personal Consumption Expenditures data, a key gauge closely watched by the central bank as it targets a 2% inflation rate, is due the next day.
Traders largely expect the central bank to leave rates unchanged this week, while expectations for a hike in December are at 77%, according to the CME's FedWatch Tool.
Although gold is typically seen as an inflation hedge, higher interest rates tend to diminish non-yielding bullion's appeal to investors.
Meanwhile, US business activity [USN:ZON00GOCU TEXT:"slowed modestly"] in October, though robust demand allowed companies to raise prices for goods and services, a sign that inflation could increase further and remain persistently high in the coming months.
Among other metals, spot silver rose 0.6% to $54.19 per ounce, platinum dropped 0.2% to $1,548.30 and palladium gained 0.2% to $1,046.25.

[２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrew Mills　Ariba Shahid

[２６日 ロイター] - 「メッカ共同防衛協定」に加盟するサウジアラビア、トルコ、パキスタンの高官は２６日、イランの首都テヘランで同国当局者と会談し、地域の連携について協議する見通しだ。事情に詳しい関係者２人が匿名を条件に明らかにした。

それによると、サウジからはハリド国防相、パキスタンからはムニール陸軍参謀長（元帥）が出席する。

関係者の１人によると、トルコの情報機関トップも参加する。

イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のバゲリ事務局次長は国営テレビに対し、サウジのハリド氏、パキスタンのムニール氏、トルコ国家情報機構のイブラヒム・カルン長官がテヘランを訪問し、同委員会と地域の安全保障について協議すると述べた。

サウジ政府の広報部門、パキスタン軍の広報部門、トルコ外務省はコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

今回予定されている協議は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジへの攻撃が激化して以降、イランとメッカ協定加盟３カ国全てが参加する初の高官級会合となる。

ムニール氏は先週もテヘランを訪れ、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領ら高官と会談した。イランメディアによると、イラン当局者はその際、自国の要求が満たされるまで米政府との協議は行わないと伝えた。

パキスタンは米国とイランの間で主要な仲介役を担ってきた。これまでの仲介努力は６月の暫定和平合意につながったが、数週間後にイランと米国の戦闘が再開し、合意は短期間で崩壊した。

フーシ派との戦闘が収まる気配を見せない中、サウジは２５日、再び飛来したミサイルとドローン（無人機）を迎撃した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　２６日　ロイター］ - 福田康夫元首相が２２日、死去した。９０歳だった。

福田氏は１９３６年７月生まれ。福田赳夫元首相の長男で民間企業勤務の後、議員秘書を経て１９９０年の衆議院議員選挙で初当選。森喜朗内閣や小泉純一郎内閣で官房長官を務めた後、２００７年に第９１代首相に就任した。首相在職日数は３６５日。

長男は福田達夫衆議院議員。

items.title: South Korea's Lee says unlikely to join Pacific trade pact within his term
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Monday that the country would not be able to join the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) during his term.
items.body:
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Monday that the country would not be able to join the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) during his term.
"We need to obtain permission from all 12 member countries" in the partnership if South Korea applies, Lee said at a meeting with farmers, fishermen and forestry workers. "The possibility that it will not be completed within my term is far higher." Lee's term runs until June 2030.
Lee [USN:P8N44G02O TEXT:"instructed"] his ministers earlier this month to not pursue an application to join the trade group, citing significant impact on South Korean farmers.
The CPTPP came into force in 2018, replacing the Trans-Pacific Partnership which fell apart after the US withdrew.

items.title: NHL roundup: Wild's Quinn Hughes makes winning return to Vancouver
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Quinn Hughes scored a goal and had an assist while reaching the 500-point career mark in his return to Vancouver, and Kirill Kaprizov scored his league-leading 13th goal and also had an assist as the Minnesota Wild defeated the Canucks 4-2 on Sunday night.
items.body:
Quinn Hughes scored a goal and had an assist while reaching the 500-point career mark in his return to Vancouver, and Kirill Kaprizov scored his league-leading 13th goal and also had an assist as the Minnesota Wild defeated the Canucks 4-2 on Sunday night.
Hughes, playing his first game in Vancouver since he was sent to Minnesota in a blockbuster trade on Dec. 12, 2025, became the second-fastest American defenseman in NHL history to reach 500 career points. Brian Leetch accomplished the feat in 496 games while Hughes, who was booed each time he touched the puck, did it in 520 games.
Maxim Shabanov scored a goal and had an assist and Bobby Brink also scored a goal for the Wild, who moved two points ahead of the Utah Mammoth into first place in the Central Division. Calvin Pickard, making just his second start of the season, finished with 15 saves for his first win with Minnesota.
Max Sasson and Brock Boeser scored goals and Leevi Merilainen finished with 30 saves for the Canucks, who lost their 10th straight game (0-9-1).
Canadiens 2, Jets 1
Jacob Fowler made 33 saves as Montreal edged Winnipeg in the Tim Hortons NHL Heritage Classic played outdoors at Princess Auto Stadium in Winnipeg.
Lane Hutson and fellow defenseman Kaiden Guhle scored, and Cole Caufield had two assists for the Canadiens in the NHL's 46th outdoor game and 10th played in Canada.
Isak Rosen scored a late goal and Stuart Skinner made 19 saves for the Jets, who have lost five in a row (0-3-2). Dawson Mercer made his Winnipeg debut after he was acquired from the New Jersey Devils as part of Friday's trade for goaltender Connor Hellebuyck and the forward had two shots in 15:22.
Panthers 3, Blackhawks 2
Lars Eller tallied the go-ahead goal with 2:23 remaining in the third period and Sandis Vilmanis and Matthew Tkachuk also scored to lift visiting Florida to a victory against Chicago.
Eller netted his first goal of the season at 17:37 of the third period as the Panthers caught the Blackhawks in a line change. Eller took a long pass from Aaron Ekblad just inside the blue line, weaved down the right side and ripped a wrist shot from the circle past Chicago goaltender Spencer Knight. Goaltender Akira Schmid stopped 19 shots as Florida snapped a two-game losing streak.
Ryan Greene and Roman Kantserov scored while Knight made 30 saves for the Blackhawks, who went 0-for-7 on the power play. Chicago fell to 2-4-0 on a seven-game homestand that is set to conclude with Tuesday's visit from the Los Angeles Kings.
Stars 6, Islanders 3
Jason Robertson scored two goals for his fourth straight multi-point performance, fueling host Dallas to a victory over New York.
Robertson scored in the first period and converted on a breakaway in the third to boost his point total to 13 (five goals, eight assists) in his last nine games. Wyatt Johnston and Tyler Seguin each collected a goal and an assist, Mikko Rantanen and Justin Hryckowian also tallied and Jake Oettinger made 17 saves to send the Stars to their fifth straight victory.
Dallas spoiled the return of Islanders head coach Pete DeBoer, who served as the Stars' bench boss for three seasons (2022-25) -- taking that club to the Western Conference final in each campaign. New York's Matthew Schaefer, 19, scored a goal for the second time in as many games and boosted his career total to 25, moving him past Hall of Famer Bobby Orr for the second most by a teenage defenseman in NHL history.
Predators 6, Avalanche 2
Ryan O'Reilly scored twice, including the game-winner, and added two assists as host Nashville beat Colorado to avoid a third straight loss and win for just the second time in seven outings (2-2-3).
Steven Stamkos scored a pair and contributed a helper for the Predators, Filip Forsberg had a goal and added two assists, and Jack Drury also tallied while Roman Josi added three helpers. Justus Annunen made 19 saves for his first win of the season.
Artturi Lehkonen and Devon Toews responded for the Avalanche, who have lost three of four and dropped to 2-4-0 on the road. Martin Necas registered two assists, and Scott Wedgewood stopped 29 shots.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rybakina finds Ningbo spark again ahead of WTA Finals title defence
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A year after winning the Ningbo Open transformed Elena Rybakina's season, the world number one returned to the Chinese city and retained her title on Sunday, as her game clicked into gear before another tilt at the WTA Finals.
items.body:
A year after winning the Ningbo Open transformed Elena Rybakina's season, the world number one returned to the Chinese city and retained her title on Sunday, as her game clicked into gear before another tilt at the WTA Finals.
Her 2025 success proved the springboard for a stellar run as she secured the last spot in the eight-player WTA Finals field the following week, before winning the season finale and carrying that momentum into the current campaign.
The 27-year-old Kazakh went on to capture the Australian Open title in January before claiming her third Grand Slam crown at the US Open last month.
Rybakina's 6-2 6-2 win over Leylah Fernandez in the [USN:L2N46B01T TEXT:"Ningbo final"] on Sunday came after she had suffered defeat in her first match as world number one in Beijing and an injury-enforced absence from Wuhan.
"It's the first time I've defended a title, so it's a great achievement," Rybakina told the WTA website.
"Ningbo is already a special place. Last year I started to play really well from this tournament. Hopefully it's going to give me motivation and good energy to continue this season and start the next one."
After losing nine of her first 13 finals, Rybakina has now won 11 of her last 15.
"I remember I was getting upset always losing in finals," she said after winning her fourth title of the year and 15th overall.
"Now it's going my way, but I can't expect it all the time ... now it's experience clicking in important moments."
Rybakina plays in the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo this week before heading to Indian Wells for the November 8-15 WTA Finals, where she went unbeaten last year to pocket over $5 million in prize money.

items.title: ノーベル平和賞マチャド氏がベネズエラ帰国、首都で数万人が歓迎
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Vivian Sequera　Sarah Kinosian　Keren Torres

[カラカス／バルキシメト ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Vivian Sequera　Sarah Kinosian　Keren Torres

[カラカス／バルキシメト ２５日 ロイター] - ベネズエラの野党指導者でノーベル平和賞受賞者のマリア・コリナ・マチャド氏が２５日、約１年ぶりに帰国した。同日夜に車で首都カラカスに入ると、数万人の支持者から歓声で迎えられた。

同氏はこれまで帰国を何度か試みたが実現せず、その過程でトランプ米政権との関係がぎくしゃくしていた。

車列が首都に入ると、マチャド氏は車のサンルーフから身を乗り出し、熱狂する支持者と握手や抱擁を交わしながら「この国は全ての人に手本を示している」と叫んだ。

マチャド氏は、２０２４年の大統領選で、後に失脚したマドゥロ氏への対抗馬として立候補することを阻まれた。その後、マドゥロ政権によって出国を禁じられていたが、１年以上にわたりほぼ身を隠して生活した後、ノーベル平和賞授賞式に合わせて２０２５年末に秘密裏に出国していた。

ロイター記者によると、マチャド氏は２５日朝、西部ララ州の教会に姿を見せた。その後、カラカスに向かったが、群衆のため移動に８時間かかった。支持者から渡されたロザリオを幾重にも身に着けた同氏がカラカス近郊に到着する頃には、幹線道路は歓声を上げる支持者でほぼ埋め尽くされていた。

同氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に「全ての家族の再会のため、全ての政治犯の自由のため、ベネズエラの自由のために」と投稿した。

マチャド氏の動向について直接説明を受けた関係者によると、帰国は米国、パナマ、コロンビアの各政府と調整された。

ホワイトハウスと国務省は、この件に関するロイターの質問に回答しなかった。

政府への報道機関の問い合わせを統括するベネズエラ通信情報省は、マチャド氏の帰国についてのコメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

教育省職員のスレイマ・グラナディージョさん（６１）は、カラカスに近いアラグア州の幹線道路沿いでマチャド氏を待った。

「マチャド氏の帰国は何を意味するのか。われわれの前にあらゆる道が開け、未来が開けている。希望の光があり、われわれは最後まで進む」とし、「われわれの指導者が戻ったことで、この独裁体制はもう終わった」と語った。

マチャド氏の外交担当首席顧問ダビド・スモランスキー氏はロイターに対し、同氏が６月にベネズエラで発生し死者を出した地震の被災者や政治犯の家族、国際社会の関係者、国内の民主化運動のさまざまな指導者と会う予定だと述べた。

「自由で公正な選挙の日程が決まるよう、積極的に働きかける」とも語った。

マチャド氏が率いる政治団体「ベンテ・ベネズエラ」は２４日、在外ベネズエラ人の有権者登録情報を収集するアプリを公開した。１５人のスタッフが過去１８カ月をかけて開発したもので、同団体は将来、改革後の選挙管理委員会とデータを共有し、利用者を正式に有権者名簿に登録できるようにしたい考えだ。

マチャド氏の政治運動の大統領候補を務め、現在はスペインで暮らすエドムンド・ゴンサレス氏はＸへの投稿で、近くベネズエラに戻り、同氏と合流すると表明した。

items.title: Six injured in Russian strikes on Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia, Chernihiv, officials say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Russian strike on Ukraine's southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia injured four people overnight, regional governor Mykhailo Semikin said on Telegram on Monday.
items.body:
A Russian strike on Ukraine's southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia injured four people overnight, regional governor Mykhailo Semikin said on Telegram on Monday.
Two more were injured in Russian strikes on the Chernihiv region, Ukraine's emergency service said on the messaging app.
Also on Telegram, the Russian defence ministry said it hit a power station in Ukraine's second largest city of Kharkiv, a warehouse in the surrounding region and another power station in the Khmelnitskiy region.
In addition, it targeted port infrastructure in Chornomorsk and a cargo vessel en route to Odesa used for military purposes, the ministry said.
The United States has pressed Ukraine to suspend strikes on Russian oil refineries, which it argues added to high energy prices, a sensitive issue for the Trump administration amid its war on Iran as midterm elections approach next month.
In an interview aired on Sunday, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy [USN:L2N46B05O TEXT:"said"] that in order for Kyiv to halt the strikes, Moscow must stop hitting power infrastructure.
Alternatively the United States should allow the use of Starshield over Russia to detect missile launch sites, or supply Ukraine with Patriot missiles, he added.

items.title: Rencontre prévue lundi entre responsables saoudiens, turcs, pakistanais et iraniens-sources
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Des hauts responsables des pays signataires de l'"accord de La Mecque" – l'Arabie saoudite, la Turquie et le Pakistan – doivent rencontrer lundi à Téhéran des responsables iraniens pour discuter de la coordination régionale, ont indiqué deux sources proches du dossier.
items.body:
Des hauts responsables des pays signataires de l'"accord de La Mecque" – l'Arabie saoudite, la Turquie et le Pakistan – doivent rencontrer lundi à Téhéran des responsables iraniens pour discuter de la coordination régionale, ont indiqué deux sources proches du dossier.
L'Arabie saoudite sera représentée par le ministre de la Défense, Khalid ben Salmane, et le Pakistan par le chef de l'armée, Asim Munir, ont précisé les sources.
Le chef des services de renseignement turcs, Ibrahim Kalin, se joindra également à la réunion, a précisé l'une des sources.
Le secrétaire adjoint de la plus haute instance de sécurité iranienne, Ali Bagheri Kani, a déclaré à la télévision publique saoudienne que Khalid ben Salmane, Asim Munir et Ibrahim Kalin se rendraient à Téhéran pour des consultations au sujet de la sécurité régionale avec le Conseil national suprême de la sécurité.
Ni le gouvernement saoudien, le bureau de presse de l'armée pakistanaise ou le ministère turc des Affaires étrangères n'ont répondu à une demande de commentaire dans l'immédiat.

items.title: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死者、最初の患者の近親者　当局は市中感染否定
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ナイロビ ２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ナイロビ ２３日 ロイター] - ケニア保健省は２３日、国内でエボラ出血熱による２人目の死者が確認されたと発表した。死亡した６５歳の女性は隔離中に症状が現れた。同国初のエボラ感染例として確認され、今月上旬に死亡したケニア人男性の近親者だった。

コンゴ民主共和国で始まった今回の流行は、これまでにアフリカ東部、中部、西部の４カ国で確認されており、アフリカでのエボラ流行の地理的広がりとしては過去最大となっている。

今月確認されたケニア初の感染例はコンゴからナイロビに渡航した男性で、５日にナイロビの病院で死亡。その後、当局は接触者１３５人を特定して全員を隔離。これまでに９人の感染が確認されている。

保健省は、国内で市中感染が広がっている証拠はないとした。

２０日にはナイジェリアがエボラ感染例を報告し、今回の流行ではアフリカ４カ国目となった。患者にはコンゴ民主共和国への渡航歴がなく、当局は感染の経路と場所の特定を急いでいる。

コンゴではエボラ感染者が１万人に迫り、４６００人以上が死亡している。

今回の流行を引き起こしているのは希少なウイルス株で、承認された治療法やワクチンはない。

items.title: Yasuo Fukuda, Japan's first second-generation prime minister, dies at 90, Nikkei reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, who used his brief period in office to seek closer ties with Asian neighbours, particularly China, has died at the age of 90, the Nikkei business daily reported on Monday.
items.body:
Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, who used his brief period in office to seek closer ties with Asian neighbours, particularly China, has died at the age of 90, the Nikkei business daily reported on Monday.
The Japanese politician, the first son of a prime minister to become premier himself, died on Thursday from heart failure, the Nikkei said.
Becoming prime minister on the sudden resignation of Shinzo Abe in 2007, Fukuda lasted less than a year — a tenure even shorter than his father Takeo's two-year stint.
A graduate in economics from Tokyo's prestigious Waseda University, Fukuda spent nearly two decades working his way up the ranks of an oil company — including a two-year posting in the United States — before resigning to become a political secretary when his father became premier in 1976.
Elected to Japan's more powerful lower house of parliament in 1990, Fukuda was chief cabinet secretary from 2000 to 2004, resigning as one of several cabinet ministers to admit not paying into the pension system.
Known for his testy manner, the bespectacled Fukuda drew criticism in 2003 for off-the-record comments in which he suggested women who dressed provocatively were asking to be raped.
When Fukuda succeeded Abe he joked he might have drawn the short straw in assuming office given the divided parliament and opposition parties' ability to delay legislation.
Frustrated with the stalled legislative process, Fukuda resigned in 2008, the second of six prime ministers to quit after only around a year in office.
Known as a diplomatic dove, Fukuda made several visits to China after leaving office in an effort to improve often fraught relations.
Fukuda leaves a son, Tatsuo, who is also a lawmaker and has been viewed as a potential future prime minister.
